title: 擬態する星座の分類学的考察 ―辺境領域における座標喪失の記録―
author: 学者 ヘルマン

en.title: Taxonomic Consideration of Mimetically Evolving Constellations: Records of Coordinate Loss in Frontier Regions
en.premise: A young naturalist discovers a banned "star chart" and an accompanying "secret map." Their investigation leads them to a terrifying hypothesis: the world they live in is actually the inside of a giant creature's digestive tract. As they unravel the laws by which the stars shift their coordinates to corner their "prey," the true form of the world is revealed.

zh.title: 拟态星座的分类学考察：边境领域坐标丧失记录
zh.premise: 一位年轻的博物学家发现了一份被禁的“星图”以及随附的“秘密地图”。经过调查，他们得出了一个令人战栗的假说：他们所居住的世界，其实是一个巨大生物的消化器官内部。当他们解开群星改变坐标、逼死“猎物”的法则时，世界的真实面目终于显露出来。
